lastCompletedStory.title: Reviewer backstops raises/suppressions across all four sibling ratchets

nextStoryContext: US-002 extends the reviewer's existing file-size-budget backstop (Conventions checklist bullet at .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md line ~86, echoed in the Layer B rubric table criterion #5 at line ~116) to cover all four sibling ratchets from US-001's per-gate rubric: file-size ceiling raises (scripts/file-size-budget.json), coverage-floor lowerings (scripts/coverage-budget.json), dead-code/knip suppressions (knip.json ignore/exclude), and dup/jscpd loosenings (.jscpd.json threshold/ignore). Coverage carries a staged _ref tracker-ref the reviewer can check (same mechanics as file-size); knip and jscpd have NO _ref channel at all, so the reviewer backstop is explicitly documented as the ONLY guard against an illegitimate suppression for those two -- do not require a fabricated _ref for them. Applied the equivalent change to both dual copies (.claude/agents/ cam-specific register, templates/agents/ generic web-app register) without forcing byte-parity, matching the CAM-260 dual-copy convention. Regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts via bun run embed-vendor; embed-vendor:check clean. Ran the full bun run check:all spine end-to-end: 4020 tests pass, typecheck/lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity all green -- no ratchet needed loosening for this story itself. Future stories: the reviewer's Layer B checklist and rubric table now name all four sibling gates explicitly by config filename (scripts/coverage-budget.json, knip.json, .jscpd.json) alongside scripts/file-size-budget.json.
